# Blueprint Schema (used by every blueprint in Chapter 13)

| Section                             | Content                                                           |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Purpose                             | What engineering task the blueprint serves and when not to use it |
| SDLC stage (F9)                     | Where it sits in the lifecycle                                    |
| Typical risk (F4) and autonomy (F3) | Defaults, adjusted by the actual risk assessment                  |
| Environment                         | Where it runs and what the harness must allow                     |
| Required inputs                     | What must exist before starting                                   |
| Task Brief (F1)                     | The reusable brief with placeholders                              |
| Execution sequence                  | Steps, with human approval points marked                          |
| Output contract                     | What is handed back                                               |
| Verification (F5)                   | Required rungs and the commands or methods                        |
| Failure handling                    | Stop conditions, escalation, rollback                             |
| Security notes                      | Data, secrets, untrusted input, permissions                       |
| Worked example                      | Completed brief and outcome from HireDesk                         |
